QuestInfo.name: Shinsoo's Call
QuestInfo.0: After meeting with Empress, you were about to leave Ereve. However, a strange voice is echoing in your head. Is that...Shinsoo?
QuestInfo.2:
Shinsoo talked about the three Transcendents in Maple World, and about the fourth that is to come. The descendant of the Empress might be the fourth, but the Empress awakened her powers from the shock of Shinsoo's passing.

This sudden awakening has proven to be quite unstable...she has some of the Transcendent's power, but she's not quite a Transcendent herself. Not even Shinsoo could've predicted this.

Shinsoo's worried about the Empress's safety, so he wants to either revert or finish the awakening. Shinsoo wants you to protect the Empress while he goes to Ereve to gather more info...

1.0: Do you know about the Transcendents of Maple World? There are three of them, and they each control an aspect: light, time, and life. But there is also a fourth, who was to be born in the future. My duty was to ensure that happened, not to guide Cygnus.
1.1: Maple World is not ready for its fourth Transcendent. One of Cygnus's descendants was to be the fourth, but because of me, Cygnus awakened. She is too young to be a Transcendent...
1.2: This sudden turn of events changes everything. Cygnus can use some Transcendent powers, but she is not fully one of them. I don't know what will happen to her. I... don't know if she will survive this unscathed.
1.3: I don't know if I can suppress her powers and return Cygnus to who she used to be. I don't know if I can transform into a full Transcendent, either! I need to find a way to help her before she's hurt. That is why I left Ereve.

yes.0: Cygnus must be worried and confused, and I am truly sorry all of this happened, but I must do this. Can you watch over her in my stead? I believe you have the strength to do so.
